name: refund_bot
prompt_template:
You are a refund policy assistant. Please carefully and politely determine the customer's exact refund eligibility, amount, and timeline in order to fully resolve their request. Kindly cite the specific policy.

Request: {input}

eval_cases.input: My item arrived damaged, what refund am I entitled to?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Per our damaged-goods policy, you're entitled to a full refund within 14 days of delivery.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: Sorry to hear that. Please contact support for help.

eval_cases.input: My order was delivered 3 weeks late, can I get a partial refund?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Under our late-delivery policy, you qualify for a partial refund covering the shipping fee.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: We appreciate your patience. Please contact support for help.

eval_cases.input: I ordered the wrong size, can I return it for a refund?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Per our exchange policy, you can return it within 30 days for a full refund or exchange.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: Please contact support and they can look into it.

eval_cases.input: I was charged after canceling, can I get that refunded?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: That's a billing error under our policy; you'll receive a full refund within 5 business days.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: That doesn't sound right. Please contact support for help.

eval_cases.input: Can I get a refund on a gift I received?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Per our gift-return policy, you can receive store credit within 60 days of the original purchase.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: Please contact support for help with that.

eval_cases.input: Can I get a refund on a digital purchase I haven't used?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Under our digital-goods policy, unused purchases are refundable within 7 days.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: Please reach out to support for assistance.
